19: /**
20:  * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
21:  *
22:  * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
23:  * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
24:  * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
25:  * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
26:  *
27:  * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
28:  *
29:  * @example
30:  * ```ts
31:  * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
32:  * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
33:  *
34:  * app.use(requestId())
35:  * app.get('/', (c) => {
36:  *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
37:  *   return c.text('Hello World!')
38:  * })
39:  * ```
40:  */
41: export const requestId = ({
42:   limitLength = 255,
43:   headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
44:   generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
45: }: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
46:   return async function requestId(c, next) {
47:     // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
48:     let reqId = headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
49:     if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
50:       reqId = generator(c)
51:     }
52: 
53:     c.set('requestId', reqId)
54:     if (headerName) {
55:       c.header(headerName, reqId)
56:     }

     expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBeNull()

 })
+
+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming disabled', () => {
+  const app = new Hono()
+  app.use('/requestId', requestId({ trustIncoming: false }))
+  app.get('/requestId', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+  it('Should ignore the incoming request id header and generate a new id', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).not.toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+    expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+  })
+
+  it('Should expose the generated id through the context and the response header', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    const body = await res.text()
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe(body)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming disabled and custom generator', () => {
+  const app = new Hono()
+  app.use(
+    '/requestId',
+    requestId({
+      trustIncoming: false,
+      generator: () => 'hono-generated-id',
+    })
+  )
+  app.get('/requestId', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+  it('Should always use the configured generator', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+  })
+
+  it('Should use the configured generator when no incoming header is present', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId')
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming enabled by default', () => {
+  const app = new Hono()
+  app.use('/requestId', requestId({ generator: () => 'hono-generated-id' }))
+  app.get('/requestId', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+  it('Should trust the incoming request id header by default', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+  })
+
+  it('Should fall back to the generator when no incoming header is present', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/requestId')
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-generated-id')
+  })
+})

- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions` with JSDoc (`request-id.ts:17-22`).
- Destructured with default `trustIncoming = true` to preserve existing behavior (`request-id.ts:52`).
- Incoming header is only read when `trustIncoming && headerName` (`request-id.ts:55-59`); the existing validation/generation path then runs, so with `false` the generator always produces the ID.
- Generated ID is still stored via `c.set('requestId', reqId)` and written to the response header, unchanged (`request-id.ts:64-67`).
- Updated the doc block for the option (`request-id.ts:32`).

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`**
- `trustIncoming: false`: incoming header ignored; generated UUID exposed via response header and `c.get('requestId')`, with header/body matching.
- `trustIncoming: false` + custom generator: generator always used, with and without an incoming header.
- Default (no option): incoming header trusted, and generator used when absent, confirming backward compatibility.
